name: Research Synthesis
description: Synthesizes multiple sources into a structured research summary: source quality assessment, finding extraction, theme identification, evidence strength rating, and contradiction mapping. Produces a research brief, not a literature review. Use when the user asks to summarize findings from multiple reports, articles, or studies, compare conclusions across sources, identify consensus and disagreement in research, or produce an evidence-based brief for decision-making. Do NOT use for qualitative coding of interview data (use qualitative-coding), automated text mining of large corpora (use text-mining-protocol), or designing original research surveys (use survey-design).
